content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research group operates a dedicated permeability testing laboratory equipped with OX-TRAN and PERMATRAN-W instruments for measuring oxygen and water vapour transmission rates across temperature gradients in packaging films.","sources":[{"id":"R0172","field":"bio","quote":"operates a dedicated permeability testing laboratory equipped with OX-TRAN and PERMATRAN-W instruments"}]},{"text":"Work on polyolefin-based multilayer and mono-material packaging films demonstrates structure–property relationships and the design of EVOH-free high-barrier systems compatible with mechanical recycling streams.","sources":[{"id":"R0172","field":"bio","quote":"transport properties of polyolefin-based multilayer and mono-material packaging films"}]},{"text":"Published research on temperature-dependent oxygen transmission rate in blown films shows that processing parameters influence both gas barrier performance and film crystallinity, with lower processing temperatures yielding better oxygen barriers.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02225","field":"abstract","quote":"At 170 °C die temperature and BUR 3.0 the lowest OTR of 310 cm³/(m²·day·bar) was obtained, corresponding to peak crystallinity of 71 %"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has strong expertise in OTR measurement and EVOH-free barrier systems [R0172], but published work focuses on conventional polyolefin and polyamide films rather than compostable polymers like PLA, which is the core material requirement for EN 13432 compliance in this challenge."}
